source: eval/sets/plans/survey-security.json (24 papers; claims checked against arXiv HTML of each cited paper, ToolHijacker via arXiv 2504.19793)
criteria_note: Scored shared criteria A-F and G plus survey-specific S1. X1 (taxonomy) applies to paper posts only and is not scored. Both posts cite all 24 plan papers. Mean of the 8 scored criteria: X 7.50, Y 7.00.

A.reason: Coherent six-lineage arc with claim headings, but the cross-lineage section and the trade-off section largely re-run earlier material (ToolHijacker defined at L616 and again at L632 'ToolHijacker는 도구 라이브러리에 악성 도구 문서 하나를 주입해...'); an AgentDojo figure is dropped at L336 after the benchmark wrap-up; L666 announces '아래 비교표는...' but the table only appears at L682 after three subsections.

B.reason: Mostly natural 입니다 prose. Deductions: formulaic attribution tags ('이 판단은 글쓴이의 해석입니다.' L290, '이 취지는 글쓴이의 해석입니다.' L318, '이는 글쓴이의 판단입니다.' L334; rewrite: fold into the sentence, e.g. '...함정을 피하려는 설계로 보입니다'); generator-style meta sentences ('...PoisonedRAG 자체의 ASR 값은 여기서 옮기지 않았으므로, 아래 비교는 상대적 순서만 다룹니다.' L640; '기반 LLM의 이름과 ... 제시되지 않았습니다.' L634); register break in the image alt text '...보안을 평가한다.' L336; citation repeated after every sentence (four identical Perez citations in L54).

C.reason: Running assistant example ties sections together and transitions are explicit. Deductions: L542 '이 결과는 앞 절에서 수치와 함께 다뤘습니다' refers to numbers never given; L137 '막대그래프는 ... ASR(초록)과 ... (빨강)' describes a chart that is not shown; L632 restarts ToolHijacker from scratch.

D.reason: Hard parts get help at the right moment: GCG/M-GCG/T-GCG defined on first use (L123), no-box defined (L616), ROP glossed (L719), DPO loss with a worked numeric value (L394: 0.693 -> 0.127), CaMeL walked through the assistant (L414). Slight over-explaining (L472 note on where 0.97 comes from).

E.reason: Figures placed where discussed, two tables and the key equations. Deductions: chart described without image (L137); '그림 1:' paper numbering in alt text (L336); mid-section table at L652 with '—' cells in the defense column (L655-656) and a second numbers table, so numbers are split over two tables.

F.reason: 1 of 42 checked claims unsupported (L634 says the paper does not tie 84.6-97.5% to a variant/model; the paper reports per-variant results in Table IX). Gap statements not scoped to the reviewed papers (L725 '정책 자동화가 아직 없습니다', '벤치마크도 아직 드뭅니다'). Otherwise numbers matched cell for cell, including the InjecAgent fine-tuned 3.8%/6.6% kept unassigned.

G.reason: use_math true with $$ present; description 135 chars, longer than title; no Liquid, no \( \) math, no pipes in math on table rows; only nit is the 한다 alt text (L336).

S1.reason: Limitation cells are mostly the papers' own (InjecAgent '단일 턴 단순화', AgentPoison '임베더 화이트박스 요구'). Deductions: re-explains things already covered (Marking re-glossed at L674 after L548-554; ETDI re-introduced at L674; StruQ/SecAlign ToolHijacker result stated three times L634, L654, L674); '—' cells at L655-656; PromptInject limitation '완전한 방어 보장 없음' is a conclusion rather than a limitation.

claim headings.evidence: e.g. '## 학습 기반 휴리스틱에서 설계상 보장으로 옮겨간 인젝션 방어' (L340), '### 검색 조건 앞에서 멈춘 그대로의 이식' (L638)

running example.evidence: email/calendar/bank assistant and '주소록을 공격자에게 전달하라' carried through every lineage (L13, L145, L262, L414, L468, L715)

mechanism -> design choice and reason ->.evidence: GCG candidate selection with reason (L176), SecAlign DPO loss with numeric example (L392-394), PoisonedRAG objective -> S/I split -> assistant example (L456-468)

facts said once.evidence: ToolHijacker defined twice (L616, L632); StruQ/SecAlign 84.6-97.5% (L634, L654, L674); GPT-4o-mini 276 (L636, L657); Marking 76% (L554, L674); MCP platform audit (L596, L670)

numbers with variant, scope and unit.evidence: Mostly scoped (e.g. 'Vicuna-7B에서 퍼플렉서티 필터링은 비적응형 ASR이 24%인데 적응형 ASR은 76%' L139), but '22.6 하락' has no unit (L306) and the 10% Max-attack gain is not scoped (L300)

nothing invented.evidence: No fabricated numbers found; L634 misreports what the ToolHijacker paper presents; unscoped field-wide gap claims at L725

writer's own assessment at the end.evidence: '## 모델 정렬을 넘어 시스템 설계로 향하는 다음 단계' with three watch points and a one-line thesis (L727-739)

length fitted to difficulty.evidence: 56.7k prose chars; the cross-lineage and trade-off sections (L626-705) mostly restate earlier results

type-specific shape (survey numbers in o.evidence: Main results table L682-705, but a second numbers table at L652-658

Korean style.evidence: Natural overall; formulaic '...글쓴이의 해석입니다' tags (L290, L318, L334), meta sentences (L634, L640), 한다 alt text (L336)

preference.reason: Both cover the 24 plan papers with a consistent running example, sound mechanism explanations and a closing assessment. X is more accurate (1 unsupported claim in 42 versus 5 wrong or unsupported in 41 for Y, including a mislabelled GCG variant and a background statistic shown as a result), and it has fewer broken cross-references. Y is tighter and better fitted in length, with one results table and little restatement, but it relies on many false back-references and describes three figures it does not show. X's main weaknesses are redundancy and meta seams, not errors. Because factual integrity weighs most, X wins narrowly.
